description: Commerce House is a professional haven built to leave a lasting impression. Offering high-quality office space in a prime location in Middlesbrough’s Historic Quarter, one of the prime business locations within Middlesbrough Town Centre. With the added benefit of Middlesbrough Railway Station being immediately opposite. Secure parking in a private carpark is definitely a bonus for this business centre. Commerce House is well suited to businesses of all shapes and sizes across a variety of sectors, Here you'll find office suites flooded with natural light, historic features and beautiful break out areas if you need some time away from your desk. Every workday at Commerce is elevated by premium amenities and meeting spaces, Including our beautiful chairman’s boardroom. There is always a welcoming face on reception in this fully staffed and serviced business centre. With ultimate flexibility, you can flex your space as your business grows or changes, ensuring efficient working without any complexity in a well-connected environment designed for professional excellence. TERMS The offices start from £600pcm for a 3 desk office. SERVICE CHARGE There will be a service charge payable for the upkeep and maintenance of common parts.
